evidence_excerpts: For matmult, the combined sequence reduces WCET from 775,720 cycles to 227,794 cycles, with register allocation saving 284,000 cycles, code SPM a further 120,000 cycles, data SPM another 135,000 cycles, and procedure positioning 8,000 cycles.
text: The WCC optimizations compose: applying register allocation, code and data scratchpad allocation, and procedure positioning to matmult reduces WCET by more than 70 percent relative to WCC -O2.
